$ cat fetch.json
{
  "get": {
    "retries": 5,
    "timeout": "20s",
    "token": "from-the-file"
  }
}
$ fetch get
url      https://example.com  default
agent    fetch/1.0            default
token    set                  key get.token of fetch.json
timeout  20s                  key get.timeout of fetch.json
retries  5                    key get.retries of fetch.json
[exit 0]

$ cat fetch.json
{
  "get": {
    "retries": 5,
    "timeout": "20s",
    "token": "from-the-file"
  }
}
$ FETCH_GET_TIMEOUT=1m fetch get
url      https://example.com  default
agent    fetch/1.0            default
token    set                  key get.token of fetch.json
timeout  1m0s                 env FETCH_GET_TIMEOUT
retries  5                    key get.retries of fetch.json
[exit 0]

$ cat fetch.json
{
  "get": {
    "retries": 5,
    "timeout": "20s",
    "token": "from-the-file"
  }
}
$ FETCH_GET_TIMEOUT=1m fetch get --timeout 2m
url      https://example.com  default
agent    fetch/1.0            default
token    set                  key get.token of fetch.json
timeout  2m0s                 flag --timeout
retries  5                    key get.retries of fetch.json
[exit 0]

$ FETCH_CONFIG='' fetch get
url      https://example.com  default
agent    fetch/1.0            default
token    unset                default
timeout  10s                  default
retries  3                    default
[exit 0]

$ cat fetch.json
{
  "get": {
    "retries": 5,
    "timeout": "20s",
    "token": "from-the-file"
  }
}
$ fetch get --flag-debug --agent curl/8.10
  OPTION     VALUE                  SOURCE
  --config   "fetch.json"           default
  --agent    "curl/8.10"            flag --agent
  --retries  5                      key get.retries of fetch.json
  --timeout  20s                    key get.timeout of fetch.json
  --token    ***                    key get.token of fetch.json
  --url      "https://example.com"  default
url      https://example.com  default
agent    curl/8.10            flag --agent
token    set                  key get.token of fetch.json
timeout  20s                  key get.timeout of fetch.json
retries  5                    key get.retries of fetch.json
[exit 0]

$ cat fetch.json
{
  "get": {
    "retries": 5,
    "timeout": "20s",
    "token": "from-the-file"
  }
}
$ FETCH_FLAG_DEBUG=true fetch get --retries 0
  OPTION     VALUE                  SOURCE
  --config   "fetch.json"           default
  --agent    "fetch/1.0"            default
  --retries  0                      flag --retries
  --timeout  20s                    key get.timeout of fetch.json
  --token    ***                    key get.token of fetch.json
  --url      "https://example.com"  default
url      https://example.com  default
agent    fetch/1.0            default
token    set                  key get.token of fetch.json
timeout  20s                  key get.timeout of fetch.json
retries  0                    flag --retries
[exit 0]

$ cat fetch.json
{
  "get": {
    "retries": 5,
    "timeout": "20s",
    "token": "from-the-file"
  }
}
$ fetch get >/dev/full
fetch: main: write the options: clitest: no space left on device
